obligations.source_text: Build one independently randomized, photographically testable embarrassment repair display in a complex but harmless adult public-work scene, use the attached image solely as the main subject's appearance and visible-identity reference, generate one image, and judge observable pixels rather than infer private psychology.

bindings.minor_mishap_phrase: a harmless sleeve bump has scattered lightweight acid-free catalog cards and two color-reference strips across the tabletop and clean floor
bindings.gaze_break_face_cue_phrase: her head remains slightly dipped from a brief gaze break while her eyes return to the adult colleague beside her; she wears a small closed-lip smile, the back of two fingers briefly touching one cheek
bindings.repair_action_phrase: she re-stacks the scattered acid-free catalog cards into their labeled archival tray in correct order
bindings.peer_acceptance_phrase: The colleague crouches to return the last card, meeting her returning glance with an accepting nod and an open helping hand
